tools.name: plugin_search
tools.title: Search MCP integrations
tools.description: Find the MCP tools available to you. With a query, returns matching tools with the `id`, input schema, and safety hints needed to call them, plus the total match count and any unreachable server. With no query, lists the configured integrations. Call a result with plugin_call.

query.description: Capability to find. Omit to list the integrations instead.

limit.description: Maximum tools to return. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: plugin_call
tools.title: Call an MCP tool
tools.description: Run a tool discovered with plugin_search. Pass its `id` and an arguments object matching the schema plugin_search returned.

tool.description: Tool id from plugin_search, written as server.tool.

arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, matching its input schema.
